import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List all source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_51/test_0.csv",

        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_51/test_9.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_51/test_10.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_51/test_11.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_51/test_12.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_51/test_13.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_51/test_14.csv"
    ]

    # Read all source tables and concatenate them
    dfs = []
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path, usecols=['title'])
        # Ensure 'title' column is integer type as per target schema
        df['title'] = df['title'].astype(int)
        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all dataframes vertically (union all rows)
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # The target schema is ['title'] with integer type, so no further transformation needed
    # Just save the combined dataframe to the target path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_51/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    combined_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
